verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents writing custom rules for what it detects (semgrep-docs-4, semgrep-docs-52), with testing (semgrep-docs-37), generic pattern matching (semgrep-docs-39), and an entropy metavariable analyzer suited to token/secret detection (semgrep-docs-40). It also supports org-private rules (semgrep-docs-36), Semgrep Secrets for credentials (semgrep-docs-8), and pre-commit scanning to keep secrets out of Git history (semgrep-docs-16). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of custom rules inside Semgrep Secrets, including custom validators for internal token formats; regex-based secret rule examples; independent hands-on corroboration of custom secret rules.
